note:
Coordinated updates: the game announces its own patches

Each client polls a static version.json once a minute against the build stamped
into its bundle. On a mismatch it shows GAME UPDATE READY with a 30s countdown,
holds while the player is in combat for up to two minutes, flushes the save,
waits for the server to confirm it, then logs out to the front door with the
name prefilled and a remembered token so returning is one click.

No admin command on purpose: a static file has no endpoint to secure and no
message a client could forge, and it fires for any push.

Adds flushSaveAsync, which awaits confirmation. LOG OUT never did that.

ship.py stamps, packs, syntax checks, commits, rebases and pushes; merges the
bundle by its EMBEDDED SOURCE when someone else has pushed, since a one-line
file cannot be text-merged; and resolves changelog collisions by keeping both
entries. Refuses to run without a patch note.
